title: Carrots in Herb Butter
preamble:
Ingredients:-
2
tbsp. Butter
2
tbsp. Water
1
tsp. Sugar
4
c. quartered carrots
Salt
and white pepper to taste
1
tsp. snipped parsley
1
tsp. snipped fresh tarragon or 1/4 tsp. dried whole tarragon, crushed

2
tbsp. Butter
2
tbsp. Water
1
tsp. Sugar
4
c. quartered carrots
Salt
and white pepper to taste
1
tsp. snipped parsley
1
tsp. snipped fresh tarragon or 1/4 tsp. dried whole tarragon, crushed

Method:-
In heavy saucepan, combine butter, water and sugar.
Add carrots, cover tightly and cook over low heat 15 to 20 minutes or until tender.
Add remaining ingredients.
Serve without draining.
